title.en: MediShield Life Scheme (Disclosure of Information) Regulations 2017

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the MediShield Life Scheme (Disclosure of Information) Regulations 2017 and come into operation on 30 November 2017.
2. The prescribed public schemes for the purposes of Part 5 of the Act are all healthcare‑related public schemes.
4. The MediShield Life Scheme (Prescribed Public Scheme for Disclosure of Information) Regulations 2015 (G.N. No. S 526/2015) are revoked.
